summary.text: Nick Schroer is a Republican state senator who has represented Missouri Senate District 2 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is an attorney and previously served in the Missouri House of Representatives from 2017 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: Nick Schroer grew up in Ferguson, Missouri, and lives in St. Charles County.

He graduated from Trinity Catholic High School in 2004, earned a bachelor's degree in criminology from the University of Missouri-St. Louis in 2008, and received a J.D. from the Southern Illinois University School of Law in 2013.
His career experience includes work as an attorney, as general counsel at Venture Group Investments, Inc., and at a firm in St. Charles County.
Schroer represented House District 107 from 2017 to 2023.

In the 2025-2026 session, he was vice chair of the Joint Committee on Administrative Rules and the Joint Committee on the Justice System and also served on joint committees on education, government accountability and transportation oversight.
